VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride

Cottonwood, AZ · Road

VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride is a road group ride in Cottonwood, AZ. It rolls every Wednesday at 8:00 am from The Neighborhood Coffee Shop. About 14–50 miles, 10–20 mph depending on the week.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the VVCC Wednesday Cottonwood Ride group ride

A midweek road ride in the Verde Valley from a Cottonwood coffee shop, with coffee back at the shop afterward. The same club also rides Tuesdays from Old Town Cottonwood and Thursdays from Sedona. Non-members can try one ride before joining.
